title: Ridge Regression Symmetry: · Ridge (L2) · Lasso (L1)
prompt: **Ridge Regression Symmetry:** In the duplicate feature case ($X_2 = X_1$), if the true relationship is $y = 4 X_1$, what weights $\hat{\beta}_1, \hat{\beta}_2$ will **Ridge ($L_2$)** assign vs. **Lasso ($L_1$)**? (Prove that $\hat{\beta}_1^2 + \hat{\beta}_2^2$ subject to $\hat{\beta}_1 + \hat{\beta}_2 = 4$ is minimized when $\hat{\beta}_1 = \hat{\beta}_2 = 2$, whereas $\ell_1$ penalty $|\hat{\beta}_1| + |\hat{\beta}_2| = 4$ is flat for any convex combination).
